verdict_rule:
Pre-declared rule (Lane E):
  For each (family f, partition P) in 6×2 = 12 primary tests:
    I(f, P) = [mean(y | T3, A) − mean(y | T1, A)] − [mean(y | T3, B) − mean(y | T1, B)]
    where (A, B) = (EXPANSION, CONTRACTION) for P1 growth or (STRESSED, CALM) for P2 stress.
    y = excess_h10_net on the PRIMARY event set (variant == '1D').
  WINNER(S): every (f, P) with Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 on H10 net,
    the same sign of I in both eras (2014-2019 and 2020-2026),
    AND all cells above floor (≥ 24 months, ≥ 100 names, ≥ 300 events, both eras present)
    — floors are evaluated on the eight (tercile ∈ {T1,T3}) × (state) × (era) cells,
    ranked by |I|/SE.
  SCOPED NULL: no (f, P) meets the winner rule AND at least 8 of 12 tests had all cells above floor.
  INSUFFICIENT SUPPORT: fewer than 8 of 12 tests had all cells above floor, OR the B1 repaired panel is absent.
Holm step-down over the 12 primary tests at α = 0.05; report raw and adjusted p.
